_meta.description: Composite Health Score — 0-100 rating with weighted metrics and thresholds for overall fitness and health assessment.
_meta.formula: Health Score = Σ (metric_score × weight) where each metric_score is 0-100

interpretation.90-100: Excellent — all systems optimal, maintain course
interpretation.40-59: Needs Work — significant health/fitness stress indicators

training_consistency.description: How consistently the user hits their weekly gym session target. Averaged across all weeks in the month.
training_consistency.formula: Average of (weekly_sessions / target_sessions × 100) across the month. Cap at 100.
training_consistency.data_source: health-automation Workouts DB: count distinct workout dates per week

calculation_details.monthly_score: average of all per_week_scores in the month

progressive_overload.description: Percentage of regularly performed exercises showing weight or rep progression over the last 3 sessions.
progressive_overload.data_source: health-automation PRs DB + Hevy exercise history via API

calculation_details.progression_check: Compare best working set volume (weight × reps) from most recent session vs session 3 ago
calculation_details.qualifies_as_progressing: Most recent best set volume > oldest best set volume

sleep_quality.description: Combined sleep duration and bedtime consistency from Apple Health data. Duration weighted 70%, consistency 30%.
sleep_quality.data_source: Health Auto Export health_data.db: sleep_duration, bedtime timestamps (30-day window)

body_composition_trend.description: Are body weight and body fat percentage moving toward the user's stated goal (cut, bulk, or maintain)?
body_composition_trend.formula: Goal-dependent. Weight change direction and body fat trend combined (60% weight, 40% BF).

green.label: On track
green.criteria: Weight and BF% moving toward goal

yellow.label: Drifting
yellow.criteria: One metric on track, one stalled or wrong direction

red.label: Off course
red.criteria: Both metrics moving away from goal

body_composition_trend.data_source: health-automation Body Metrics DB: weight_lbs, body_fat_pct (30-day window)

supplement_adherence.description: Percentage of scheduled supplement doses actually taken, tracked via the Medications DB.
supplement_adherence.data_source: health-automation Medications DB: status field (taken/missed/skipped) for type='supplement'
supplement_adherence.notes: Counts both AM and PM supplement windows. Missing a full day counts as 2 missed doses.

recovery_average.description: Rolling 30-day average of daily recovery scores from Module B.

green.label: Well-recovered
green.criteria: Average recovery score ≥75 — body is adapting well

recovery_average.data_source: health-planner Module B daily recovery scores (stored in memory/health_data)

cardio_fitness.description: VO2 max level and trend from Apple Health, scored against age-adjusted fitness percentiles.
cardio_fitness.formula: Base score from VO2 max percentile, adjusted ±5 points for 90-day trend direction.
cardio_fitness.data_source: Health Auto Export health_data.db: vo2_max readings
cardio_fitness.notes: VO2 max may not update frequently from Apple Watch. Use most recent reading within 30 days. If no reading available, default to 50 (neutral).

lab_markers.description: Percentage of tracked biomarkers currently within their optimal reference range.
lab_markers.data_source: health-automation Lab Results DB + Lab Markers DB (optimal ranges)
lab_markers.notes: Only count markers with at least one lab result in the past 12 months. Markers with no recent data are excluded from the denominator.

format.per_metric_breakdown: table with score, weight, weighted contribution, and status emoji
format.top_recommendation: Single most impactful action to improve score
format.biggest_opportunity: Metric with highest (100 - score) × weight product
